metadata.name: Underwater Dashboard
metadata.description: A real HTML analytics dashboard seen through a live water simulation: drag ripples across it, search it, watch new orders slide in while the numbers refract. Uses Chrome 157's HTML-in-Canvas; other browsers get the same dashboard as plain HTML. Light and dark. More at kit.neebarp.com
